From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T10:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MediValley — controller/processor confirmation + SOC 2 request (need legal input)

Neha / Laura — quick guidance from legal: 

1) Controller / Processor mapping: confirm in writing that MediValley is Controller; Redwood will be Processor. We should document the mapping in the DPA (standard).

2) SCC module: recommend requesting the EU Standard Contractual Clauses Module Two (Processor to Controller) — that matches the Controller-led relationship. We usually propose the "Processor-to-Controller (Module Two)" module in the first draft.

3) BAA versus DPA: For HealthTech customers where PHI is in scope we prefer to issue a standalone BAA supplement that attaches to the DPA (keeps HIPAA-specific obligations clearer). So send DPA + BAA appendix; legal will prepare a draft BAA template.

4) Likely redlines to proactively address in our first draft: 
- Subprocessor list and 30-day notice for new subprocessors; offer on-demand subprocessor disclosures for high-risk subprocessors.
- Audit scope: provide SOC 2 Type II snapshot and allow in-person or third-party audit with reasonable notice and scope limitations.
- Data retention & deletion: standard deletion on termination clause but be explicit for PHI; allow for customer-initiated export and deletion windows (we support 90-day export/deletion by default for enterprise/private deploys).
- Liability: customers will push for no-cap on PHI incidents — point them to our standard carveouts; legal to discuss limited exceptions.

5) Documents to provide immediately: redacted SOC 2 Type II (we can share a redacted PDF) and a pen-test executive summary. I’m attaching the SOC 2 redacted file for MediValley review.

I’ll draft the DPA (Module Two variant) and the BAA appendix and share for your review by EOD 11/26. Meanwhile, Neha — go ahead and prefill the Redwood sections of the security questionnaire (service description, SOC/pen-test references, infra details) and send the prefilled version to MediValley.

David Kim
